message:
♦️ FLEX ULTIMATE V2.1.0 IS OFFICIALLY LIVE! (PREMIERE PRO)[cite: 4]

Version 2.1.0 brings a major, non-destructive overhaul to Unnest, ensuring the creative edits, color grades, and motion applied to a nest are never lost when expanded back to your main timeline[cite: 4].

(Tip: Quit Premiere Pro completely and reopen it after updating so the new panel build loads cleanly[cite: 4].)

♦️ Intelligent Non-Destructive Unnest
* Carry Nest-Level Edits: Lumetri grades, zooms, repositioning, rotation, and opacity ramps applied directly to a nest clip are automatically transferred to an Adjustment Layer above the expanded clips with all keyframes preserved[cite: 4].
* Zero Timeline Clutter: Clean nests with untouched motion expand naturally without generating unnecessary adjustment layers[cite: 4].
* Safe Track Targeting: Transferred adjustment layers scan from the bottom up and sit strictly on the first genuinely free track, creating new tracks when needed so existing media is never overwritten[cite: 4, 5].
* Transparent Diagnostics: If an effect cannot be re-applied, a nest has speed changes, or an Adjustment Layer item is missing from your project, Unnest explicitly informs you instead of failing silently[cite: 4].

♦️ Fail-Safe Placement & Audio Handling
* Rollback on Failure: Retains the original nest intact until extraction completes, removing partial or staged clips if a placement fails[cite: 5].
* Accurate Audio Isolation: Expanding a video-only selection no longer duplicates unselected nested audio tracks[cite: 5].
* Speed & Effect Guards: Conservative checks safeguard clips with speed changes or unsupported nest-level audio processing to prevent corrupted timeline states[cite: 5].

♦️ UI Fixes
* Responsive State Reset: Fixed the Unnest button remaining lit for ten seconds after execution or staying focused when clicking elsewhere on the panel[cite: 4].
